title: One product name: MyAPES Account
summary: MyAPES Account is now the only product name you will see, in page titles, the footer, Help, legal pages and documentation.
changes: Replace the old name "MyAPES Core" with "MyAPES Account" in page titles, the footer, the service badge, Help, privacy, cookie and terms pages, and error and maintenance pages.
Every page title now ends with "| MyAPES Account", including ticket, case, consultation and recruitment pages.
Update the web app manifest, documentation, issue templates and release notes to the same name.
version_rationale: Minor: opens the 0.45 quick-wins series with a visible product rename. Routes, permissions and stored data are unchanged.
validation: PublicChromeNamingTest checks titles, footer and manifest, and fails if the old name returns to views or lang.
TerminologyGlossaryTest, ChangeLogPageTest, BrandedErrorPagesTest, PublicLegalPagesTest and HardCodedStringInventoryTest.
Manual check of the home page, footer and page titles in the local preview.
known_limitations: Earlier release notes keep the name they were published with.
rollback: Redeploy the previous release package. No database change is involved.
